description: Symptoms shown on the GoFix tablet's issue-selection step. Symptom is customer-facing language ("Battery draining fast") that the backend can map to a service category later.

fields.label: Symptom (customer-facing)
fields.description: Text the customer sees, e.g. "Screen cracked / broken".

fields.label: Symptom Code
fields.description: IRIS-style symptom code (e.g. BAT-01) for OEM claim/analytics export

fields.label: Not-Sure / Expert Check
fields.description: Marks the "Not sure / need expert check" option. The tablet enforces that this option cannot be combined with any other symptom.

fields.label: Other (free text)
fields.description: Marks the "Other" option. Selecting it reveals the optional additional-notes textarea; typing remains optional.

fields.label: Backend Issue Category
fields.description: Optional map to the existing Issue Category master so downstream Service Request analytics stay consistent.

name: GoFix Symptom
